lines: # Travels to Sky Isle and back. Run with /function msm_examples:sky_isle/travel, or step through the portal.
execute if dimension msm_examples:sky_isle in minecraft:overworld run return run spreadplayers ~ ~ 0 64 false @s
execute in msm_examples:sky_isle run spreadplayers ~ ~ 0 64 false @s

meta.notes: The travel function. execute in msm_examples:sky_isle runs spreadplayers in the dimension, which puts you on solid ground within 64 blocks. Run inside the dimension, the first line takes you back to the overworld the same way (if dimension …, then return).
